From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>

Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>

Subject: Post-discovery recap + propose 30m demo slots & stakeholder priorities

Hi Mark / Priya —

Thanks again for taking the time earlier today. Quick recap from our discovery call and suggested next steps so we can lock in a short product intro (30 minutes) that covers the items that matter most to your team.

Recap (high level):
- Current pain: unpredictable inference cost + inconsistent latency across batches for your analytics pipelines
- Important constraints: HIPAA-adjacent PII handling, prefer VPC-only deployment, monthly cost budget target (~$8k)
- Primary stakeholders: Mark (Platform/Infra), Priya (Data + Compliance), plus one ML lead for model behavior questions

Proposed 30-minute demo goals:
1) Quick show-and-tell of Redwood API + Dedicated routing options (10 min)
2) KV cache & batching demo with latency numbers (10 min)
3) Q&A on deployment/ops and next steps (10 min)

Attached is a short proposed agenda and a template SOW for your review.

Can you confirm which of the following 3 windows works best for the broader group? I listed time zones in PDT and included a recommended attendee list next to each slot. If none of these work, propose alternatives and we’ll adapt.

- Option A: Mon Dec 13, 11:00–11:30 AM PT — Attendees: Mark, Priya, Aditya (solutions)
- Option B: Tue Dec 14, 9:00–9:30 AM PT — Attendees: Mark, ML lead (TBD), Irene
- Option C: Wed Dec 15, 1:30–2:00 PM PT — Attendees: Priya, Mark, Aditya

Ask: please reply with preferred option + confirm the ML lead’s name (or I can invite a placeholder). If you want a deeper technical session we can extend to 45–60 min, but for now I recommend keeping it focused to get alignment.

Thanks —
Irene

Thanks Mark — we can tentatively hold Option B (Tue Dec 14, 9:00–9:30 AM PT).

Quick answers:
- KV cache & PII: by default we do not persist KV cache outside the inference runtime; when configured in Private/VPC mode, cache lives in ephemeral memory on customer-controlled instances and can be disabled for specific routes. We’ll include a short slide in the demo to show the exact flow and retention controls.
- For Sanjay: if Tue morning doesn’t work, we can move to Option C (Wed 1:30 PT) — Marissa (copied) will run the demo and is available both slots.

Next steps:
1) Mark — confirm Sanjay’s availability (name + will he join live?)
2) Priya — any compliance docs you'd like ahead of the demo? We can bring our security lead if desired.
3) Aditya/Marissa — please review slides and be ready to demo KV cache example and cost/latency numbers (short, concrete numbers preferred).

If I don’t hear back by end of day Monday we’ll assume Option B tentative and send a calendar invite with a placeholder for Sanjay.

Best,
Irene
